entries.clue: Study indications characteristic in body of water north-west of Iceland (7,6)

entries.clue: Betray 20 in Rome? (6-5)

annotation.definitionFit: To double-cross someone is to betray them after pretending to be on their side.

entries.clue: No problem, mostly, to kick out professional of high rank (5)

annotation.walkthrough: Two cuts in sequence: trim the M, then lift PRO out of the middle, and NO + BLE closes up.
annotation.definitionFit: Noble describes someone of high rank by birth, an aristocrat.

entries.clue: Suffering US heading for transformation (9)

annotation.surface: America, in pain, is bound for change.

entries.clue: On reflection, I would spot content of fake sport that's not breathtaking? (7)

annotation.definitionFit: Kabaddi is a sport whose raider may not take a breath during a raid, hence 'not breathtaking'.

entries.clue: Scruffy final character in Breakfast at Tiffany's eviscerated (5)

annotation.walkthrough: The film title is not a unit: each word does its own job, and the 's is 'has', so Tiffany has been eviscerated.
annotation.definitionFit: Tatty means shabby and worn, scruffy.

entries.clue: It sprinkles holy water in breathing apparatus, according to initiates (9)

annotation.definitionFit: An aspergill is the brush or perforated globe a priest uses to sprinkle holy water.

entries.clue: Spits next to hat? It makes me speechless (10)

annotation.walkthrough: A gobstopper is a very large, hard, round sweet, big enough to fill the mouth and stop you talking; 'gob' is British slang for mouth as well as for spit.
annotation.definitionFit: With a gobstopper in your mouth you cannot speak.

entries.clue: Dribble excitedly over upper-class American singer (8)

indicatorNotes.excitedly: the letters jump about into a new order

annotation.walkthrough: 'Singer' looks like a human star, but in crosswords it is often a songbird.
annotation.definitionFit: 'Singer' is crossword shorthand for a songbird, and the bluebird is a songbird native to North America.

entries.clue: Delivery from first of youthful employees unwrapped (6)

indicatorNotes.unwrapped: the wrapping, the outer letters, is taken off

annotation.walkthrough: In cricket a yorker is a ball bowled to land right at the batsman's feet; 'delivery' is the usual cricketing word for a bowled ball, not a parcel.
annotation.definitionFit: A cricket sense: every ball bowled is a delivery, and the yorker is one kind, aimed at the batsman's toes.

entries.clue: Stretcher produced after basic dental works (7,4)

annotation.definitionFit: A cryptic sense: 'stretcher' is read literally as 'thing that stretches' rather than as a carrying bed.
